inline.en-US: And the Word was made flesh and dwelt amongst us.

Divine Infant Jesus, I adore Thy Cross and I accept all the crosses Thou wilt be pleased to send me. Adorable Trinity, I offer Thee for the glory of Thy Holy Name of God, all the adorations of the Sacred Heart of the Holy Infant Jesus.

text.en-US: Three Our Fathers in honour of the Holy Family, each preceded by the aspiration.
text.pt-BR: Três Pai-Nossos em honra da Sagrada Família, cada um precedido da jaculatória.

text.en-US: The Twelve Years of the Holy Childhood
text.pt-BR: Os Doze Anos da Santa Infância

text.en-US: Twelve Hail Marys in memory of the twelve years of the Sacred Infancy of our Divine Saviour, each preceded by the aspiration.
text.pt-BR: Doze Ave-Marias em memória dos doze anos da Sagrada Infância do Divino Salvador, cada uma precedida da jaculatória.

inline.en-US: Holy Infant Jesus, bless and protect us.
